DIDP-VBEAM.description: Design Input Data Position - Virtual Beam (DIDP-VBEAM). Selects which member ends (I/J) are checked for moment and shear on a PSC-design Virtual Beam; both fields are integer codes 0=None, 1=I, 2=J, 3=I & J.

MOMENT_TYPE.description: Moment check position. 0=None, 1=I, 2=J, 3=I & J. Values outside 0-3 are rejected.

SHEAR_TYPE.description: Shear check position. 0=None, 1=I, 2=J, 3=I & J. Values outside 0-3 are rejected.
